title: From Daniel Jones and Anthony Richardson to vaunted CB tandem, 4 takeaways from Colts training camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: From Daniel Jones and Anthony Richardson to vaunted CB tandem, 4 takeaways from Colts training camp
sources.description: The Colts believe Jones can run back the type of performance that sparked their 8-2 start last year. The key for Jones will be understanding not just how his Achilles is progressing but also how he's otherwise tweaking any mechanics.
